text_en: The beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
text_cn: 天主子耶稣基督福音的开始，

text_en: As it is written in the prophet Isaiah, “See, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way;
text_cn: 正如先知《依撒意亚书》上记载的：“看，我派遣我的使者在你面前，预备你的道路。

text_en: the voice of one crying out in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight, ’”
text_cn: 旷野中有呼号者的声音：你们当预备上主的道路，修直他的途径。”

text_en: John the baptizer appeared in the wilderness, proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
text_cn: 洗者若翰便在旷野里出现，宣讲悔改的洗礼，为得罪之赦。

text_en: And people from the whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem were going out to him, and were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
text_cn: 犹太全地和耶路撒冷的群众都出来，到他那里，承认自己的罪过，在约但河里受他的洗。

text_en: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
text_cn: 若翰穿的是骆驼毛的衣服，腰间束的是皮带，吃的是蝗虫与野蜜。

text_en: He proclaimed, “The one who is more powerful than I is coming after me; I am not worthy to stoop down and untie the thong of his sandals.
text_cn: 他宣告说：“那比我更有力量的，要在我以后来，我连俯身解他的鞋带也不配。

text_en: I have baptized you with water; but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit. ”
text_cn: 我以水洗你们，他却要以圣神洗你们。”

text_en: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
text_cn: 在那些日子里，耶稣由加里肋亚纳匝肋来，在约但河里受了若翰的洗。

text_en: And just as he was coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens torn apart and the Spirit descending like a dove on him.
text_cn: 他刚从水里上来，就看见天裂开了，圣神有如鸽子降在他上面；

text_en: And a voice came from heaven, “You are my Son, the Beloved; with you I am well pleased. ”
text_cn: 又有声音从天上说：“你是我的爱子，我因你而喜悦。”

text_en: And the Spirit immediately drove him out into the wilderness.
text_cn: 圣神立即催他到旷野里去。

text_en: He was in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan; and he was with the wild beasts; and the angels waited on him.
text_cn: 他在旷野里，四十天之久，受撒殚的试探，与野兽在一起，并有天使服侍他。

text_en: Now after John was arrested, Jesus came to Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God,
text_cn: 若翰被监禁后，耶稣来到加里肋亚，宣讲天主的福音，

text_en: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God has come near; repent, and believe in the good news. ”
text_cn: 说：“时期已满，天主的国临近了，你们悔改，信从福音罢！”

text_en: As Jesus passed along the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the sea—for they were fishermen.
text_cn: 当耶稣沿着加里肋亚海行走时，看见西满和西满的兄弟安德肋，在海里撒网，他们原是渔夫。

text_en: And Jesus said to them, “Follow me and I will make you fish for people. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“来跟随我！我要使你们成为渔人的渔夫。”

text_en: And immediately they left their nets and followed him.
text_cn: 他们便立刻抛下网，跟随了他。

text_en: As he went a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John, who were in their boat mending the nets.
text_cn: 耶稣向前行了不远，看见载伯德的儿子雅各伯和他的弟弟若望，正在船上修网。

text_en: Immediately he called them; and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men, and followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣遂立即召叫他们；他们就把自己的父亲载伯德和佣工们留在船上，跟随他去了。

text_en: They went to Capernaum; and when the sabbath came, he entered the synagogue and taught.
text_cn: 他们进了葛法翁；一到安息日，耶稣就进入会堂教训人。

text_en: They were astounded at his teaching, for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
text_cn: 人都惊奇他的教训，因为他教训他们正像有权威似的，不像经师们一样。

text_en: Just then there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit,
text_cn: 当时，在他们的会堂里，正有一个附邪魔的人，他喊叫，说：

text_en: and he cried out, “What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are, the Holy One of God. ”
text_cn: “纳匝肋人耶稣！我们与你有什么相干？你竟来毁灭我们！我知道你是谁，你是天主的圣者。”

text_en: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him! ”
text_cn: 耶稣叱责他说：“不要作声！从他身上出去！”

text_en: And the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
text_cn: 邪魔使那人拘挛了一阵，大喊一声，就从他身上出去了。

text_en: They were all amazed, and they kept on asking one another, “What is this? A new teaching—with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him. ”
text_cn: 众人大为惊愕，以致彼此询问说：“这是怎么一回事？这是新的教训，并具有权威；他连给邪魔出命，邪魔也听从他。”

text_en: At once his fame began to spread throughout the surrounding region of Galilee.
text_cn: 他的声誉遂即传遍了加里肋亚附近各处。

text_en: As soon as they left the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
text_cn: 他一出会堂，就同雅各伯和若望来到了西满和安德肋的家里。

text_en: Now Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they told him about her at once.
text_cn: 那时，西满的岳母正躺着发烧；有人就向耶稣提起她来，

text_en: He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up. Then the fever left her, and she began to serve them.
text_cn: 耶稣上前去，握住她的手，扶起她来，热症遂即离开了她；她就伺候他们。

text_en: That evening, at sunset, they brought to him all who were sick or possessed with demons.
text_cn: 到了晚上，日落之后，人把所有患病的和附魔的，都带到他跟前，

text_en: And the whole city was gathered around the door.
text_cn: 阖城的人都聚在门前。

text_en: And he cured many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and he would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew him.
text_cn: 耶稣治好了许多患各种病症的人，驱逐了许多魔鬼，并且不许魔鬼说话，因为魔鬼认识他。

text_en: In the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up and went out to a deserted place, and there he prayed.
text_cn: 清晨，天还很黑，耶稣就起身出去，到荒野的地方，在那里祈祷。

text_en: And Simon and his companions hunted for him.
text_cn: 西满和同他在一起的人都去追寻他，

text_en: When they found him, they said to him, “Everyone is searching for you. ”
text_cn: 找到了他，就向他说：“众人都找你呢！”

text_en: He answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns, so that I may proclaim the message there also; for that is what I came out to do. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“让我们到别处去，到邻近的村镇去罢！好叫我也在那里宣讲，因为我是为这事出来的。”

text_en: And he went throughout Galilee, proclaiming the message in their synagogues and casting out demons.
text_cn: 他遂到加里肋亚各地，在他们的会堂里宣讲，并驱逐魔鬼。

text_en: A leper came to him begging him, and kneeling he said to him, “If you choose, you can make me clean. ”
text_cn: 有一个癞病人来到耶稣跟前，跪下求他说：“你若愿意，就能洁净我。”

text_en: Moved with pity, Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, and said to him, “I do choose. Be made clean! ”
text_cn: 耶稣动了怜悯的心，就伸手抚摸他，向他说：“我愿意，你洁净了罢！”

text_en: Immediately the leprosy left him, and he was made clean.
text_cn: 癞病立时脱离了他，他就洁净了。

text_en: After sternly warning him he sent him away at once,
text_cn: 然后，耶稣严厉警告他，立即催他走，

text_en: saying to him, “See that you say nothing to anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them. ”
text_cn: 并向他说：“当心！什么也不可告诉人，但去叫司祭检验你，并为你的洁净，奉献梅瑟所规定的，给他们当作证据。”

text_en: But he went out and began to proclaim it freely, and to spread the word, so that Jesus could no longer go into a town openly, but stayed out in the country; and people came to him from every quarter.
text_cn: 但那人一出去，便开始极力宣扬，把这事传扬开了，以致耶稣不能再公然进城，只好留在外边荒野的地方；但人们却从各处到他跟前来。
